description: This file contains utility functions and class definitions related to HR management in an ERP system, including employee data handling, leave management, holiday processing, and validation routines.

classes.name: DuplicateDeclarationError
classes.description: Custom exception class for duplicate declaration errors in HR processes.

methods.name: set_employee_name
methods.description: Sets the employee name on a document if not already set, based on employee ID.

methods.name: update_employee_work_history
methods.description: Updates the internal work history of an employee, adding or modifying records.

methods.name: delete_employee_work_history
methods.description: Deletes specific employee work history records based on provided details and date.

methods.name: get_employee_fields_label
methods.description: Returns a list of employee fields with labels for UI display.

methods.name: get_employee_field_property
methods.description: Retrieves properties of a specific employee field, including value, datatype, and options.

methods.name: validate_dates
methods.description: Validates date ranges for employee-related documents, ensuring logical consistency.

methods.name: validate_overlap
methods.description: Checks for overlapping date ranges in employee records to prevent conflicts.

methods.name: get_doc_condition
methods.description: Generates SQL condition strings for specific document types to check overlaps.

methods.name: throw_overlap_error
methods.description: Raises an error when overlapping records are detected.

methods.name: validate_duplicate_exemption_for_payroll_period
methods.description: Ensures no duplicate exemption records exist for the same payroll period and employee.

methods.name: validate_tax_declaration
methods.description: Validates that tax exemption subcategories are not duplicated.

methods.name: get_total_exemption_amount
methods.description: Calculates total exemption amount from a list of tax declarations, respecting maximum limits.

methods.name: get_leave_period
methods.description: Fetches active leave periods within a date range for a specific company.

methods.name: generate_leave_encashment
methods.description: Creates draft leave encashment entries based on expiry and settings.

methods.name: allocate_earned_leaves
methods.description: Allocates earned leaves to employees based on policies and dates.

methods.name: update_previous_leave_allocation
methods.description: Updates leave allocation records with earned leaves and creates ledger entries.

methods.name: get_monthly_earned_leave
methods.description: Calculates monthly earned leave based on annual leave, frequency, and rounding.

methods.name: get_leave_allocations
methods.description: Retrieves leave allocations for a given date and leave type.

methods.name: get_earned_leaves
methods.description: Returns all leave types marked as earned leave.

methods.name: create_additional_leave_ledger_entry
methods.description: Creates ledger entries for leave allocations.

methods.name: check_effective_date
methods.description: Determines if a date is effective based on leave frequency and date of joining.

methods.name: get_salary_assignment
methods.description: Fetches the latest salary structure assignment for an employee on a given date.

methods.name: get_sal_slip_total_benefit_given
methods.description: Calculates total flexible benefit amount given to an employee in a payroll period.

methods.name: get_holiday_dates_for_employee
methods.description: Returns a list of holiday dates for an employee within a date range.

methods.name: get_holidays_for_employee
methods.description: Retrieves holiday details for an employee, with filtering options.

methods.name: calculate_annual_eligible_hra_exemption
methods.description: Stub for Indian HRA exemption calculation, used for localization.

methods.name: calculate_hra_exemption_for_period
methods.description: Stub for Indian HRA exemption calculation over a period, used for localization.

methods.name: get_previous_claimed_amount
methods.description: Calculates total claimed amount for benefits within a payroll period.

methods.name: share_doc_with_approver
methods.description: Shares a document with its approver if they lack permissions, and manages sharing permissions.

methods.name: validate_active_employee
methods.description: Checks if an employee is active; throws error if inactive.
